info.title: Commerce OS API
info.description: Commerce OS private API. REAL default for normal reads; mutations require an explicit environment. Conflicting body/query environments fail with ENVIRONMENT_CONFLICT. Legacy ambiguous mutations fail with ENVIRONMENT_REQUIRED. Service capabilities are workspace, environment and resource scoped. Lab simulations never dispatch to WAHA. SENT means provider accepted, DELIVERED requires delivery ACK, READ requires a read receipt; none proves portal access.

ownerPersonalToken.description: Token personal cos_pat_ de un owner vigente; authentication_method=personal_access_token. No es un token de servicio. Mantiene las autorizaciones operativas independientes.
